general.notes: Product pair: SO-SFP-100Base-BX20D-35 (TX 1310nm / RX 1550nm) and SO-SFP-100Base-BX20D-53 (TX 1550nm / RX 1310nm). Transmit wavelength ranges: BX20D-35 1260–1360nm (footnote 1); BX20D-53 1500–1580nm (footnote 2). Receiver wavelength ranges: BX20D-35 1500–1580nm (footnote 1); BX20D-53 1260–1360nm (footnote 2). Power budget stated as 0–14dB (FE) and 0–13dB (STM1/OC3). Power consumption < 1.0W. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C also listed in summary column.
